Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You can try different courses (and more than 30 ECTS) in the first weeks and then select at the end of the registration period

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I mostly just used the course website, and talked to other students.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was successful in registering for all the courses i wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Make use of the first two weeks of flexibility so you can talk to lectures and hear about the course. The workload is usually lower in the start, so it should be possible to be at more than 30 ECTS of lectures.

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I mostly just took electives in the MA of statistics at ETH.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The lectures were very similar. The exercise classes were more of a presentation of exercises and lecture material, compared to UCPH, where one might discuss the solutions.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Probabilistic Artificial Intelligence, great course for probabilistic thinking in Machine Learning. 
Machine Learning in Finance and Insurance. Covers all the theory for statistical learning, with practical projects
High-Dimensional Statistics. Great deep-dive into LASSO and derivative models.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I really like their punctuality and how proper they are.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
If you plan to take 30 ECTS points, then you should probably spent more time studying to have the same grade.

The exams are planned very late (for Autumn end November - early December), and you can have exams for the first two weeks of the semester if you are here in the Autumn. 

Many lectures are recorded, so you might be able to take two courses that have lectures at the same time.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Getting to know a lot of different people and try a different academy culture.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Getting use to the unwritten and written rules about courses, assignments, exams and lectures. At the start I was afraid of uploading the assignments wrong, or making another weird mistake.
